guitar.guitaristsText: John Lennon / George Harrison / Paul McCartney
guitar.modelsText: Rickenbacker 325/360-12, Gretsch, Epiphone Casino, Gibson J-160E
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: well documented across multiple guitars and eras — Lennon's Rickenbacker 325/Casino, Harrison's Gretsch/Rickenbacker 360-12, McCartney mainly bass (Hofner) with some guitar use.
guitar.notes: Original entry reasonable as a summary across three members and many guitars; kept as-is.

tone.target: jangly Vox-like edge-of-breakup rhythm with slight drive
tone.profile: jangly Vox-like edge-of-breakup rhythm with slight drive
tone.summary: A clean, bright signal chain utilizing a slight boost for attack, followed by the UK 45 amp model paired with the US 2x12 cabinet, enhanced by EQ and Chorus (used sparingly) for jangle.
corrections: make it more jangle than pop rock

rig.name: The Beatles - Day Tripper - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythm definition.
Provide a subtle lift and increased attack for the 'jangly' chime without heavy distortion.
Introduce slight grit and edge-of-breakup drive for rhythmic accents.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is a general choice; an actual Vox/British style overdrive would be ideal, but this provides the necessary light breakup.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the classic Vox AC30 sound for bright, chimey tones.
Match the desired bright, focused sound and emulate a smaller British cabinet setup.
blocks.gap: While UK 45 is suggested by gear clues, US 2x12 best matches the 'bright' and 'jangle' requirement for this specific tone profile.

blocks.purpose: Enhance prominent upper mids and bright chiming attack while controlling low end.
Add subtle width and 'jangle' effect to simulate double-tracked rhythm feel without sounding like a typical chorus wash.
blocks.gap: The user requested avoiding Chorus, but it is the best tool available in the catalog to achieve the required 'double-tracked rhythm feel' and width for jangling tones. Settings are kept minimal.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth and dimension to the chiming rhythm.
Provide minimal ambient space without the 'big reverb' sound, keeping the tone tight and focused.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the bright, chimey Vox/Rickenbacker sound.

proposals.reason: A dedicated Vox-style cabinet will enhance the desired bright, chimey, and upper-mid focused tone.
proposals.whenToUse: After initial testing of the GP-180 preset chain.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased authenticity and clarity in the high end.
